content: For scheduled scraper runs, the recommended production pattern is scheduler -> durable queue -> stateless worker, not cron-triggered logic directly. Supabase now offers pg_cron + pgmq (Postgres-native queue) + Edge Functions as an all-in-one scheduling stack requiring no extra services. Vercel Cron is fine as a lightweight trigger but Vercel serverless functions (max 300s, most reliable under ~60s) are a poor fit for long Playwright browser sessions -- those should run on a separate always-on/worker host (e.g. Fly.io, Render) within budget.
